data.name: 第三监视局
data.detailed_description:
Past midnight, the only light on your face is the cold glow of the monitors.




On the graveyard shift, check the surveillance cameras deployed across the district one by one, spot changes that deviate from the ordinary, and make critical calls before danger closes in.

Outside the window, the woods have fallen into dead silence; inside the control room, only the low hum of humming equipment remains.
The footage refreshes again and again, yet you can never be entirely certain—was that corner really the same just a second ago?

The Third Surveillance Bureau is a 2D horror game centered on surveillance and anomaly identification.

Switch between security cameras, search for irregularities hidden in the frames, and report them in time.

Find What Deviates from the Ordinary


Anomalies don't always appear in obvious ways.

It might just be an extra item sitting on a desk, something missing from a pile of trash, or a familiar place you've seen countless times that suddenly feels unnervingly strange tonight.

All you can rely on is your keen observation, sharp memory, and the instinct every Surveillance Bureau employee must possess.

Bring Back the Intrigued Artifacts


During your shift, you will also collect items left behind by anomalies.

Examine their records and logs, piecing together the true picture of events from seemingly insignificant details.

Never overlook something just because it looks ordinary.

Fight Anomalies with Anomalies


Not every anomaly can be dealt with simply by filing a report.

Understand them, exploit them, and determine when to use them.

At the Third Surveillance Bureau, anomalies are not just targets to handle—they might be the only tools you have left.

Survive the Lengthening Night


At first, it seems like just another routine night shift.

Yet as the night progresses, seemingly unrelated anomalies, artifacts, and records gradually point toward something much harder to comprehend.

The monitored district remains quiet.

Streetlights flicker erratically, doors remain shut, and wanderers occasionally pass across the screen.

Except... something has irrevocably changed.

When the anomalies cease to be mere oddities on the surveillance screens, you may realize—

What is truly terrifying might not be the monsters.

It is the horror hidden behind the anomalies—a reality closer and more chilling than any monster could ever be...

Game Features


  • Observe and identify anomalies across multiple surveillance camera feeds
  • Assess anomalies and report them before impending danger strikes
  • Collect items, uncover hidden information and piece together clues
  • Utilize the unique properties of various anomalies to counter them
  • Unravel the hidden truth layer by layer through relentless night shifts



Tonight, it's your shift.

Power on the system and stay alert.

The night is deep, and the long road ahead has only just begun.



Night Return Games Presents

data.short_description: Watch the monitors, spot anomalies, and protect citizens in the dead of night. The Third Surveillance Bureau is a 2D horror game centered on surveillance. Cycle through camera feeds, report irregularities in time, and uncover a reality far more terrifying than monsters.
data.supported_languages: Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Korean

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8400 / AMD Athlon 200GE
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / AMD Radeon HD 6570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 630 / AMD Radeon RX 550
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 Catalina or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2.0 GHz / Apple M1
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus Graphics / Apple integrated graphics
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: macOS-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required. 1280x720 minimum resolution.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2.5 GHz / Apple M1 or later
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus Graphics / Apple integrated graphics
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: macOS-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: 1920x1080 recommended.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent bloody and violent horror imagery, including realistic depictions of injury, corpses, accidental death, and detailed scenes of extreme violence or gore. It also includes depictions or references to suicide and criminal activity, mild profanity, and alcohol, smoking, or unauthorized use of medication. The game creates a dark, oppressive atmosphere with intense psychological horror. It contains no sexual content, nudity, sexual violence, gambling, or online interaction.
